basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | junior research fellow: MSc/ MTech in Physics/ Chemistry/ Materials Science/ Nanotechnology/ Ceramics Engineering/Polymer Science, Solid State Physics.

salary_details.details: The position is a consolidated fellowship offered for the duration of the appointment till 28-05-2027.

how_to_apply: Prepare a detailed softcopy of your CV.
Compile all relevant Essential Qualification documents, Degree Certificates, Marks Sheets, GATE qualifying certificates, and Date of Birth Proof Certificate into a single PDF file.
Send the single PDF file via email to [email protected].
Mention the subject line as “Application for JRF - [Your Name]”.
Ensure the application is sent before 30-10-2026.
important_instructions: Candidates who have qualified NET/GATE will be given preference. Candidates with expertise in synthesis of inorganic materials, crystal structure and microstructure determination using powder XRD, SEM, TEM, Raman spectroscopy, etc., or basic electrochemistry characterization are strongly encouraged to apply. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. Selected candidates will be informed by email.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for this notification?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore).

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this vacancy?
faq.answer: The post name is Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 30-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the essential educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an MSc or MTech in Physics, Chemistry, Materials Science, Nanotechnology, Ceramics Engineering, Polymer Science, or Solid State Physics.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly fellowship amount?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow will be paid a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month plus HRA if applicable.

faq.question: Q8. How should candidates apply for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit a detailed softcopy of their CV and supporting documents in a single PDF file to [email protected] with the specified subject line.

faq.question: Q9. When is the date of the interview?
faq.answer: The date of the interview is 09-11-2026.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.
